info.title: 1BIS Backend API
info.description: Welcome to the 1BIS API documentation. This is a RESTful API that allows you to interact with the 1BIS backend services.

bearerAuth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer {token}'

id.description: The unique identifier of the user

email.description: The email address of the user

password.description: The hashed password of the user

firstName.description: The first name of the user

lastName.description: The last name of the user

token.description: JWT authentication token (only in login response)

post.description: Register a new user with person details and authentication credentials

400.description: Validation error or user already exists

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token

Set-Cookie.description: JWT token set as HTTP-only cookie

post.description: Logout user and clear JWT token cookie

put.description: Update a user's password by user ID

get.description: Retrieve a specific batch by its unique identifier with optional field selection

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include (supports nested fields with dot notation)

patch.description: Update batch data by ID (partial update)

description.example: Updated description for the batch

delete.description: Permanently delete a batch by ID

get.description: Retrieve batchs with advanced filtering, pagination, sorting, field selection, and optional grouping

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to sort by or JSON object for multi-field sorting

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include (supports dot notation)

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query to filter by name or description

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: JSON array of filter objects for advanced filtering

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Group results by a field name

batchs.description: Present when document="true" and no groupBy

groups.description: Present when groupBy is used and document="true"

post.description: Create a new batch with the provided data

description.example: Welcome email batch for new users
